title: Something pale is growing on the wall
description: It carries its own faint light, and it has grown across the passage in the shape of a hand.

choices.text: Read what it is before anyone touches it.

onPass.narration: Cavelight, and the good kind. It packs into the satchel and keeps.

onFail.narration: It bursts at a touch and the spores go everywhere. The coughing lasts an hour.

choices.text: Put a shield to it and press through.

onPass.narration: It comes away in sheets. Behind it is a niche somebody sealed and never came back for.

onFail.narration: It comes away in sheets, and so does the wall behind it.

onPass.narration: The long way is a long way. It is also a way.
